text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Lately, my joints have been hurting for 
some reason... I even made my friend worry 
about me. But I'm still okay, so...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's what I thought, so I hid it. But in 
the end, my body just wouldn't move 
right... I really thought I was completely 
done for.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...When I cried like a child, Trainer 
gently encouraged me. Saying, 'It's okay, 
it's okay'..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And then, it really was fine after all! 
I... I've actually hit my growth spurt!
